prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey item shop in a forest village built among giant trees (rustic log houses, carved wood, lanterns). thick golden-brown straw thatch roof walls of stacked round logs with notched corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). a hanging wooden sign with a potion-flask icon beside the door. A striped red-and-cream fabric awning over a window. A small iron wall lamp next to the door (unlit glass). The whole image is 240 x 192 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached layout-guide image into ONE isolated forest-village item shop sprite. Treat the attachment as a STRICT PIXEL-EXACT GEOMETRY TEMPLATE, not inspiration: canvas 1680 x 1344 corresponding to 240 x 192 logical art pixels at 7x nearest-neighbor enlargement. Preserve roof outer rectangle x=14..1666 y=196..938, horizontal roof face split y=523..537, log wall x=56..1624 y=939..1343, front door x=763..917 y=1120..1343, left glowing window x=350..463 y=1120..1261 and right glowing window x=1204..1317 y=1120..1261, same placements and dimensions. Front door MUST remain a visible walk-through dark brown rectangle at the ground/bottom edge, not a hanging sign or a shutter. Roof is an enormous thick golden brown straw thatch roof SEEN FROM ABOVE, upper colored block of template, richly detailed chunky directional straw clumps and neat thick thatch eaves; lower block under horizontal split is the front-facing edge of roof. Below roof a one-story front-facing stacked round log wall with dark notched log corners; two amber-glowing small paned windows EXACTLY in guide's positions. Red and cream striped small fabric awning above LEFT window without blocking window. Small hanging carved wooden potion-flask icon sign beside door, small unlit iron-and-glass wall lantern beside door. Optional tiny chimney above roof. Do not move or obscure window rectangles or door. Crisp premium hand-placed HD JRPG pixel art, absolutely uniform 7x7 square pixels on entire image, hard cluster boundaries, no antialiasing, blur, gradient, noise, dithering, or photographic appearance. Materials with four to six discrete earthy tones, warm yellow straw highlights, saturated reddish-purple shadows, calm EVEN daylight overcast upper-left, no cast shadows, no vignette, no lamp light pools; amber windows ONLY light sources. Magenta background of guide MUST be replaced with full alpha transparency, including outer top/side margin, no ground or cast shadow. No text, letters, people or additional buildings.
